finding: Extraction skips unused LF/HF/TD families per channel, but computes all statistics within each retained family before selecting output columns. This is family-level selection, not individual-feature selection.
equivalence: Selected outputs match corresponding full-feature columns within rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-6.
scope: The audit describes the archived implementation. Existing saved runtimes remain unchanged. It does not measure an optimized individual-feature implementation.
